publish_request.title: How small ecommerce teams can reduce missed leads
publish_request.body:
Small ecommerce teams often lose leads in the space between form submission and follow-up.

A connected lead intake workflow can capture submissions, validate required fields, check duplicates, update the CRM, and alert the team.
publish_request.excerpt: A practical workflow map for reducing missed lead handoff problems.
